description: This source file defines the SlugifyParameterTransformer class that implements the IOutboundParameterTransformer interface to transform outbound route parameters into a slugified form by converting camel case strings to hyphen-separated lowercase strings.

classes.name: SlugifyParameterTransformer
classes.description: A class implementing IOutboundParameterTransformer to transform route parameters into slug format.

methods.name: TransformOutbound
methods.description: Transforms an object value into a slugified string by inserting hyphens between camel case words and converting to lowercase.
